name: @pragma-sh/antigravity-plugin
description: Google Antigravity CLI (agy) plugin that reports agent status to Pragma via native hooks.

scripts.build: bun build src/pragma-plugin.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target node --packages bundle && mv dist/pragma-plugin.js dist/pragma-plugin.mjs && bun build scripts/install-local.ts --outfile dist/install.mjs --format esm --target node --packages bundle && bun build src/hook/main.ts --outfile agy-plugin/dist/hook.mjs --format esm --target node --packages bundle && cp assets/antigravity.svg agy-plugin/dist/logo.svg
scripts.install:local: bun run build && bun run scripts/install-local.ts
